reader_summary.headline: Blake is the co-founder and CEO of ID.me, a secure digital identity network with over 100 million members.
reader_summary.overview: Blake is the co-founder and CEO of ID.me, a secure digital identity network with over 100 million members. He was an officer in the United States Army and served our country for four years as a a rifle platoon leader. We explore his formative years in the military and transition into entrepreneurship.

key_points.text: He was an officer in the United States Army and served our country for four years as a a rifle platoon leader.
Blake shares powerful stories from his time leading scout sniper missions in Iraq.
He shares the origin and evolution of ID.me, a company dedicated to verifying digital identities to combat fraud and simplify login experiences.
